refnamediv.refpurpose: Fit filter B(z)/A(z) or B(s)/A(s) to complex frequency response at frequency points F.

refsynopsisdiv.title: Syntax
refsynopsisdiv.synopsis: [B, A] = invfreq(H, F, nB, nA) [B, A] = invfreq(H, F, nB, nA, W) [B, A] = invfreq(H, F, nB, nA, W, [], [], plane) [B, A] = invfreq(H, F, nB, nA, W, iter, tol, plane)

listitem.para: Desired complex frequency response. It is assumed that A and B are real polynomials, hence H is one-sided.
Vector of frequency samples in radians.
(optional) Vector of weights for frequency samples. Default is uniform weighting.
(optional) Number of Steiglitz-McBride iterations. Default is no iterations.
(optional) Tolerance for Steiglitz-McBride iterations. Default is no tolerance.
(optional) Transform plane. Either "z" for discrete-time spectra (default) or "s" for continuous-time spectra.

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: The `invfreq` function fits a rational transfer function B(z)/A(z) or B(s)/A(s) to the desired complex frequency response `H` at frequency points `F`. The orders of the numerator and denominator polynomials are specified by `nB` and `nA`, respectively. Optionally, the fit-errors can be weighted using the weights `W`. The transform plane can be specified as either "z" for discrete-time or "s" for continuous-time. By default, the z-plane is used.
The function supports Steiglitz-McBride iterations for iterative refinement of the solution, specified by `iter` and `tol`.
